title: Basics of Candlesticks
author: MrMarket
description: A clear, step-by-step way to read price charts: from your first candle to a complete trade plan, with real examples on Emaar, Emirates NBD and Apple. Follow along in TradingView with the practice workbook.
disclaimer: This course is for education only and is not investment, financial or trading advice. Nothing here is a recommendation to buy or sell any stock, currency or other instrument. The charts and companies shown (such as Emaar Properties, Emirates NBD and Apple) are illustrations of candlestick patterns, not opinions on those companies. Examples include trades that did not work out; past patterns do not predict future results. Trading involves risk, including the loss of your capital. Practise on a demo account first and consider speaking to a licensed adviser before trading real money.

title: Price Action Mastery
author: Aseem Singhal
description: Learn to read naked charts with no indicator clutter. You'll find structure, key levels and high-quality setups, then plan every trade with entry, stop and target. Examples on Emaar, Emirates NBD and Apple, including trades that failed. Follow along in TradingView with the practice workbook.
disclaimer: Education only, not investment or trading advice. Charts and companies shown are illustrations, not opinions. Past patterns do not predict future results. Trading risks your capital. Practise on a demo account first.

title: Risk Management and Position Sizing
author: Aseem Singhal
description: A practical, step-by-step system for controlling losses and sizing trades, from your first risk rule to a full account plan. Use the position size calculator and trade journal template in the practice workbook. Examples on Emaar, Emirates NBD and Apple, including losing trades and drawdowns. Follow along in TradingView and Excel or Google Sheets.
disclaimer: Education only, not investment or trading advice. Charts, companies and numbers shown are illustrations, not recommendations. Risk rules reduce losses but cannot remove them. Trading risks your capital. Practise on a demo account first.

title: Smart Money Concepts
author: Kavya Iyer
description: A step-by-step framework for reading structure, liquidity and imbalance on a clean chart. You'll learn to mark key zones, wait for confirmation and plan every trade with entry, stop and target. Examples on Emaar, Emirates NBD and Apple, including setups that failed. Follow along in TradingView with the practice workbook.
disclaimer: Education only, not investment or trading advice. Smart money concepts are an interpretation of price behavior, not proof of what any institution is doing. Charts and companies shown are illustrations, not recommendations. Past patterns do not predict future results. Trading risks your capital. Practise on a demo account first.

title: MT5 from Zero to Live
author: Rohit Mehra
description: A hands-on, step-by-step guide to MetaTrader 5, from setup and charting to orders, position sizing, going live and basic automation. Every lesson is screen-recorded so you can follow click by click. Examples on EURUSD, gold and Apple. Use the practice workbook with a free demo account.
disclaimer: Education only, not investment or trading advice. Nothing here is a recommendation to buy or sell any instrument, or to use any particular broker. Examples are illustrations, and some trades shown did not work out. Leveraged trading carries a high risk of losing your capital. Practise on a demo account first and consider speaking to a licensed adviser before trading real money.

title: Build Your First EA in MQL5
author: Neel Shah
description: A step-by-step, code-along guide to building an Expert Advisor in MQL5, from basic syntax to trade execution, risk management, backtesting and a demo run. You'll build one complete EA from a simple rules-based strategy and get the full source code in the practice workbook. Examples on EURUSD, gold and Apple. Follow along in MetaEditor and the MT5 Strategy Tester.
disclaimer: Education only, not investment or trading advice. The EA built in this course is a teaching example, not a profitable system or a recommendation. Backtest results do not predict live results. Automated trading carries a high risk of losing your capital, and code errors can cause unintended trades. Test on a demo account first and consider speaking to a licensed adviser before trading real money.

title: Trading Psychology
author: Dr. Meera Rao
description: A practical, step-by-step guide to the mental side of trading, from understanding your own biases to building a routine, a journal and a plan for bad days. Use the trade journal, pre-trade checklist and weekly review templates in the practice workbook. Examples drawn from real trades on Emaar, Emirates NBD and Apple, including mistakes. Follow along in TradingView and Excel or Google Sheets.
disclaimer: Education only, not investment, financial or trading advice, and not a substitute for professional mental health support. Nothing here is a recommendation to buy or sell any instrument. Examples are illustrations, and some trades shown did not work out. Trading risks your capital. Practise on a demo account first and consider speaking to a licensed adviser before trading real money.

title: Technical Indicators Made Simple
author: MrMarket
description: A clear, step-by-step guide to the most used technical indicators, from moving averages and RSI to MACD, Bollinger Bands and VWAP. You'll learn what each one shows, where it fails and how to build a simple indicator stack with a trade plan. Examples on Emaar, Emirates NBD and Apple, including signals that failed. Follow along in TradingView with the practice workbook.
disclaimer: Education only, not investment or trading advice. Indicators are tools that describe past price and volume, and they do not predict the future. Charts and companies shown are illustrations, not recommendations. Past patterns do not predict future results. Trading risks your capital. Practise on a demo account first.

title: Classic Chart Patterns
author: MrMarket
description: A complete guide to reversal and continuation patterns, from double tops and head and shoulders to flags, wedges and cup and handle. For each pattern you'll learn how to identify it, confirm the breakout, place the stop and measure a target. Examples on Emaar, Emirates NBD and Apple, including patterns that failed. Follow along in TradingView with the practice workbook.
disclaimer: Education only, not investment or trading advice. Chart patterns are an interpretation of price and often fail. Charts and companies shown are illustrations, not recommendations. Past patterns do not predict future results. Trading risks your capital. Practise on a demo account first.

title: Backtesting Trading Strategies
author: MrMarket
description: A practical guide to testing trading ideas, from writing clear rules to running manual, spreadsheet, Python and MT5 backtests. You'll learn the key performance metrics, how overfitting happens and how to use out-of-sample and walk-forward testing. Examples on Emaar, Emirates NBD, Apple and EURUSD. Use the testing templates and sample Python code in the practice workbook.
disclaimer: Education only, not investment or trading advice. Backtest results are hypothetical and do not predict live results. Strategies shown are teaching examples, not recommendations or profitable systems. Trading risks your capital. Test on a demo account first and consider speaking to a licensed adviser before trading real money.

title: Swing Trading Playbook
author: MrMarket
description: A complete method for trading multi-day moves, from building a watchlist to entries, stops, targets and a weekly routine. You'll learn six core setups and how to size positions so no single trade hurts your account. Examples on Emaar, Emirates NBD and Apple, including losing trades. Follow along in TradingView with the practice workbook and trade journal.
disclaimer: Education only, not investment or trading advice. Nothing here is a recommendation to buy or sell any stock. Holding trades overnight and over weekends carries gap risk that stops cannot fully remove. Examples are illustrations, and some trades shown did not work out. Trading risks your capital. Practise on a demo account first.

title: Intraday and Scalping Strategies
author: MrMarket
description: A hands-on guide to day trading and scalping, from market sessions and pre-market prep to opening range breakouts, VWAP pullbacks and one-minute scalps. You'll learn execution, daily loss limits and how costs affect short-term results. Examples on Emaar, Emirates NBD, Apple and EURUSD, including losing days. Follow along in TradingView with the practice workbook and trade journal.
disclaimer: Education only, not investment or trading advice. Day trading and scalping carry a high risk of loss, and most short-term traders lose money. Costs such as spreads, commissions and slippage can erase small edges. Examples are illustrations, and some trades shown did not work out. Practise on a demo account first and consider speaking to a licensed adviser before trading real money.

title: Forex Trading Fundamentals
author: MrMarket
description: A step-by-step introduction to forex trading, from pairs, pips and lots to central banks, economic data and technical setups. You'll learn position sizing, leverage and how to build a simple trading plan, and how to spot common scams. Examples on EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY and gold. Follow along in TradingView or MT5 with the practice workbook.
disclaimer: Education only, not investment or trading advice. Nothing here is a recommendation to buy or sell any currency, or to use any particular broker. Leveraged forex trading carries a high risk of losing your capital, and rules differ by country. Examples are illustrations, and some trades shown did not work out. Practise on a demo account first and consider speaking to a licensed adviser before trading real money.

title: Fibonacci and Harmonic Patterns
author: MrMarket
description: A focused guide to Fibonacci retracements and extensions and the main harmonic patterns, including Gartley, Bat, Butterfly, Crab and Cypher. You'll learn how to choose swing points, confirm entries, place stops and test whether a setup has worked in the past. Examples on Emaar, Emirates NBD, Apple and EURUSD, including patterns that failed. Follow along in TradingView with the practice workbook.
disclaimer: Education only, not investment or trading advice. Fibonacci levels and harmonic patterns are subjective, and two traders can draw them differently. Charts and companies shown are illustrations, not recommendations. Past patterns do not predict future results. Trading risks your capital. Practise on a demo account first.

title: Building Your Trading Plan and Journal
author: MrMarket
description: A practical guide to writing a complete trading plan, from goals, market and style to entry, exit and risk rules. You'll set up a trade journal, learn which metrics matter and build a weekly review routine to find your strengths and leaks. Examples on Emaar, Emirates NBD and Apple. Use the plan template, journal sheet and review checklist in the practice workbook.
disclaimer: Education only, not investment or trading advice. The sample plans and journal entries shown are illustrations and not recommendations. Your plan should reflect your own finances, goals and risk tolerance. Trading risks your capital. Practise on a demo account first and consider speaking to a licensed adviser before trading real money.
